mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (particularly magnesium and potassium), which impairs renal function and increases risedronate accumulation and toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration, monitor serum electrolytes especially magnesium and potassium, and consider alternative antifungal agents if possible; ensure adequate spacing of doses and assess necessity of concurrent use.
